full_judgment: This Rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 27.6.84 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court Dhaka and S.C.C. Judge in S.C.0 Suit No. 19 of 1980 dismissing a suit for eviction. The petitioner as plaintiff filed the suit against the defendant for eviction from the suit premises situated In Dhaka City on the allegation that he required the house bonafide for his personal use and occupation and for the use and occupation of his sons, daughters and family. The suit was contested by the defendant disputing plaintiff's claim of bonafide requirement of the house. The learned Trial Court on consideration of the evidence adduced by both the parties held that the plaintiff has failed to prove that the suit premises was actually bonafide required by the plaintiff for his personal use and occupation and dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved the plaintiff bas moved this Court and obtained the present Rule.
